tabBrowser.showPageIcon.description: Show the icon of the loaded page on the panel's tab. The icon is downloaded from the page's own server; turn this off to keep the browser panel from making that request.

tabBrowser.copyAsFile.markdownDescription: Put multi-line copies (the element report and console output) on the clipboard as a temporary file next to their text, so pasting them into a chat attaches a document. Falls back to plain text on platforms without clipboard file support, in remote workspaces, and for one-line copies such as "Copy element XPath".

tabBrowser.notifyOnCopy.description: Show a notification after the copy menu has written to the clipboard. When disabled only a status bar message is shown.

enumDescriptions: Full element context: descriptor, url, html path, outer html, dimensions and the css that applies
CSS selector, e.g. #root > main > ul > li:nth-of-type(3)
CSS selector and XPath on two lines
Full JSON payload with selector, xpath, tag, attributes, dimensions and styles
tabBrowser.picker.copyFormat.description: What "Copy element" writes to the clipboard. "Copy element XPath" always writes an XPath.

tabBrowser.picker.keepActiveAfterPick.description: Keep element picking enabled after an element has been picked.

tabBrowser.picker.preferAttributes.description: Attributes that are preferred over structural selectors when building an element path.

enumDescriptions: Route localhost urls through the local instrumenting proxy; other urls are only proxied once the copy menu needs them
Always route http/https urls through the local instrumenting proxy
Never use the proxy. The copy menu will not be available
tabBrowser.proxy.mode.markdownDescription: The copy menu requires the page to be served through a local proxy that injects a small script, because a cross-origin `iframe` can be neither inspected nor read from the webview.

tabBrowser.proxy.ignoreCertificateErrors.description: Ignore TLS certificate errors when the proxy talks to an https target (useful for local dev servers with self-signed certificates).
